description: Phase 4B: UI integration, polish, and playable demo preparation

tasks.name: Fleet movement UI on galaxy map
tasks.description: Add fleet movement controls to galaxy map. Click fleet to select, click destination star to issue move order. Show movement range, ETA, and path. Fleets in transit should render between stars.
acceptance: Click fleet icon to select it
Selected fleet shows movement range circle
Click destination star to issue move order
Path line shows route to destination
Fleets in transit render along path

tasks.name: Combat resolution UI screen
tasks.description: Complete the CombatScreen to show tactical combat. Display hex grid with ships, allow unit selection, movement, and firing. Show damage numbers, explosions, and combat log.
acceptance: Hex grid renders with ships positioned
Click ship to select, show movement range
Click hex to move selected ship

tasks.name: Complete diplomacy UI
tasks.description: Finish DiplomacyScreen with all treaty actions, relation display, and AI response handling. Allow proposing/accepting treaties, declaring war, and viewing relation history.
acceptance: Empire list shows all known empires
Relation bar (-100 to +100) with color coding
Treaty status icons (NAP, Trade, Alliance, War)
Propose treaty dropdown with all treaty types

tasks.name: Colonization flow UI
tasks.description: Add colonization UI flow. Colony ships in orbit at uncolonized habitable planets show 'Colonize' button. Clicking triggers colonization and opens planet management.
acceptance: Colony ship at uncolonized planet shows Colonize button
New colony appears on map with empire color
Planet management screen opens after colonization
Cannot colonize hostile planets without tech

tasks.name: Turn summary/events screen
tasks.description: Create turn summary screen that shows between turns. Display research completed, ships built, combats resolved, diplomatic events, random events.
acceptance: Shows after Next Turn is clicked
Continue button returns to galaxy map

tasks.name: Save/Load game UI
tasks.description: Create save/load game screens accessible from menu. Show save slots with game info (turn, year, empires). Allow saving, loading, and deleting saves.
acceptance: Each slot shows turn, year, player empire
Save button saves current game to slot
Delete button removes save with confirmation

tasks.name: Complete research screen
tasks.description: Finish ResearchScreen with tech selection, progress display, and field allocation. Show available techs per field, costs, and effects.
acceptance: Each field shows current research target
Click field to see available techs
Tech list shows cost, turns to complete
Select tech to set as current research

tasks.name: Colonies list screen (F2)
tasks.description: Create ColoniesScreen showing all player colonies in a sortable list. Display population, factories, current build, and production stats.
acceptance: Shows current build queue item per colony
Click colony name to open planet screen
Accessible via F2 or command bar

tasks.name: Fleets list screen (F3)
tasks.description: Create FleetsScreen showing all player fleets. Display location, destination, ship counts, and fleet commands.
acceptance: Shows fleet location (system name or 'In Transit')
Click fleet to select on galaxy map
Accessible via F3 or command bar

tasks.name: High Council screen UI
tasks.description: Create CouncilScreen showing Galactic High Council. Display vote shares, current leader, and voting UI when council convenes.
acceptance: Shows all empires with vote share %
Vote for self or another empire

tasks.name: Espionage UI
tasks.description: Create espionage interface. Show spy allocation per empire, mission selection, and results. Integrate with diplomacy screen.
acceptance: Shows spy count per target empire
Mission type selector (sabotage, steal tech, etc)

tasks.name: Ground combat results UI
tasks.description: Create ground combat resolution UI. Shows when troops invade a planet. Display attacker/defender strength, combat rolls, and result.
acceptance: Final result: planet captured or invasion failed

tasks.name: Victory/defeat screens
tasks.description: Create victory and defeat screens. Show win condition met (Conquest, Diplomatic, etc) with stats and credits.
acceptance: Play again button starts new game

tasks.name: Keyboard hotkeys (F1-F8)
tasks.description: Implement keyboard navigation. F1=Galaxy, F2=Colonies, F3=Fleets, F4=Design, F5=Research, F6=Diplomacy, F7=Council, F8=Save. Also arrow keys for map pan.

tasks.name: Verify all design doc constants in code
tasks.description: Audit all formulas and constants in design docs. Ensure each one appears in src/game/constants.ts with proper documentation. Run check-design script.
acceptance: All formulas in design docs have code equivalents
Each constant has doc source reference
No magic numbers in game systems

tasks.name: Playable demo integration test
tasks.description: Create end-to-end test that plays through a game: new game, colonize, build ships, combat, diplomacy, victory. Verifies all systems integrate correctly.
acceptance: Test creates new game with 2 empires
